policy: Exclude only non-target or nonglossed metalinguistic material; retain every actual target lexical/grammatical attestation and all directly aligned specimen units.

exclusions.description: Administrative ethnonyms saiqalgars/sigligars/sikligars, Persian saiqal-gar and Arabic saqal in the caste-name explanation, and san in the quoted description are not asserted as Sikalgari lexical examples.

Gujarati -tho, vepari, upay, kapas, chhokro and melwu, plus tentative Munda kat/kan comparison and Siyalgiri sound comparison, remain source comparisons rather than new Sikalgari forms or inferred graph edges. Exact forms and qualifications are retained by the original page witness and corresponding source-unit notes where attached.

Discussion-only sound components g/go, kh/s, ch/chh, n/p, t, kat, got, gal, khl/kl, d and p are not standalone lexical records. Their real glossed examples are all included. The four explicitly functioning case suffixes are included with case tags and intentional blank lexical glosses.
Full English translation of SpecimenII is preserved in specimen-source-witness.pdf as context; no unattested word-level alignment is inferred from it.
